title: Using the most popular job board doesn't always work 🔎
description:
If you're getting sick of using LinkedIn or Indeed for job boards, check out these alternative sites. Lots of people use LinkedIn and Indeed since they are the most popular but that also means they are the most saturated. Using a smaller job board can help you find new types of roles and in the case of “GetWork” direct you right to the company website to apply. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobboard #linkedin #linkedintips
